usageNotes: Use this to inspect the DNS resolver configuration (up to three nameservers and the search domain) currently active on a specific node's /etc/resolv.conf. The target node must be online and reachable by the API; the caller needs Sys.Audit on /nodes/{node}. All returned fields are optional — a node with minimal config may return only a subset.

examples.summary: Read DNS settings from node pve1

tips: All response fields (dns1, dns2, dns3, search) are optional; check for their presence before using them.
To update DNS settings, use the corresponding PUT endpoint (update_nodes_node_dns).
In a cluster, each node stores its own /etc/resolv.conf — query each node individually if you need a cluster-wide view.
